summary.behavior: Outer reticle radius selector (target). radius = level.hackertoollockonradius; priority chain: (1) care package -> radius = target.hackertoolradius (with assert); (2) hackable weapon object -> getweaponobjecthackerradius( target ); (3) target.hackertoolouterradius when defined; (4) target.hackertoolradius when defined. Returns radius. Mirrors unit 119 but reads the outerradius-specific field; when neither specific outer field exists, care/weapon-object paths still reuse the same single radius (making inner == outer and disabling the scale lerp in hackingtimescale).

summary.behavior: Grenade-pullback event handler (eventstruct; self = player; tagged event_handler[grenade_pullback]). Branches: if !isplayer( self ) -> return; weapon = eventstruct.weapon; if ( isdefined( level.weaponhackertool ) && weapon.rootweapon == level.weaponhackertool ): waitframe( 1 ); currentoffhand = self getcurrentoffhand(); if ( self isusingoffhand() && currentoffhand.rootweapon == level.weaponhackertool ): starts four threads: self thread hackertooltargetloop( weapon ); watchhackertoolend( weapon ); watchforgrenadefire( weapon ); watchhackertoolinterrupt( weapon ). Fires when the player pulls back to the hacker tool; no other state.

summary.behavior: Full lock-state reset (weapon, successfulhack, spawned; self = player). Ordered clears: notify #"stop_lockon_sound"; notify #"stop_locked_sound"; notify #"clearhackertarget"; self.stingerlocksound = undefined; stoprumble( "stinger_lock_rumble" ); self.hackertoollockstarttime = 0; self.hackertoollockstarted = 0; self.hackertoollockfinalized = 0; self.hackertoollocktimeelapsed = 0. Branch A: if isdefined( weapon ) -> self setweaponhackpercent( weapon, 0 ); if isdefined( self.hackertooltarget ) -> heatseekingmissile::setfriendlyflags( weapon, self.hackertooltarget ). Branch B: if successfulhack == 0: ( if spawned == 0 && isdefined( self.hackertooltarget ) -> self playsoundtoplayer( #"evt_hacker_hack_lost", self ) â€” lost-target sound only on failed, non-spawn resets ); then self clientfield::set_to_player( "hacker_tool", 0 ); self stophackertoolsoundloop(). Branch C: if isdefined( self.hackertooltarget ) -> heatseekingmissile::targetinghacking( self.hackertooltarget, 0 ) â€” releases the heatseekingmissile hack flag; then self.hackertooltarget = undefined; self weaponlockfree(); self weaponlocktargettooclose( 0 ); self weaponlocknoclearance( 0 ). Explicit recovered dev-block (/# ... #/; original target-build inclusion/exclusion unknown): self heatseekingmissile::destroylockoncanceledmessage().

summary.behavior: Hackable-target enumeration and selection (weapon; self = player). Build: targetsvalid = []; targetsall = arraycombine( target_getarray(), level.missileentities, 0, 0 ); then arraycombine( targetsall, level.hackertooltargets, 0, 0 ) â€” two literal arraycombine calls over native target list, missile entities and registered hackertool targets; dedup/union/ordering semantics unresolved. Per-entry: skip when !isdefined( target_ent ) or !isdefined( target_ent.owner ). Explicit recovered dev-block (original target-build inclusion/exclusion unknown): if getdvarint( #"scr_freelock", 0 ) == 1 -> reticle-only accept path. TEAM path ( level.teambased || level.use_team_based_logic_for_locking_on === 1 ): care package: if self cantargetentity( target_ent, weapon ) -> add; else if target_ent.team defined: if target_ent.team != self.team && cantargetentity -> add (team filter rejects own team); else if target_ent.owner.team defined: same owner-team filter; then continue (team path ends the iteration). FREE path (non-team): if self iswithinhackertoolreticle( target_ent, weapon ): if care package -> cantargetentity -> add, continue; if isdefined( target_ent.owner ) && self != target_ent.owner -> cantargetentity -> add (ownership filter rejects own entities). Selection: if targetsvalid.size != 0 -> chosenent = targetsvalid[ 0 ] (first accepted element in resulting array; no native-then-missile-then-registered order guarantee without arraycombine contract); return chosenent or undefined.

summary.behavior: Inner reticle radius selector (target). radius = level.hackertoollockonradius (25 from init_shared; may be overwritten by the tunables loop). Priority chain: (1) isentityhackablecarepackage( target ) -> assert( isdefined( target.hackertoolradius ) ) then radius = target.hackertoolradius; (2) isentityhackableweaponobject( target ) -> radius = getweaponobjecthackerradius( target ); (3) isdefined( target.hackertoolinnerradius ) -> radius = target.hackertoolinnerradius; (4) isdefined( target.hackertoolradius ) -> radius = target.hackertoolradius. Returns radius. Per-entity override fields win over the level default; weapon objects read their watcher radius.
